description: Three calls Frostlake used to answer where the account refuses. The first is a ROW-time refusal: a _STRING decoder hands back a VARCHAR, so bytes that spell no UTF-8 string are an error rather than a lossy conversion - Java's decoder substitutes the replacement character, and a one-byte 0xAB came back as a one-character string. Live answers "Invalid UTF8 detected while decoding 'qw=='", quoting the INPUT as written, and the TRY_ spellings answer NULL while valid text still decodes and the _BINARY decoders never read the bytes at all. The other two are COMPILE-time argument-type refusals, each keyed to a family the function will not read: JSON_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT takes JSON text or a VARIANT and refuses an OBJECT, TRY_VALIDATE_UTF8 reads its argument as text and refuses a BINARY. Both name the offending types with the argument list's own widths. Converted 1:1 from functions/DecodedTextAndArgumentRefusalTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach eb fixture is inlined per test, and JSON_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT over a number is asserted as SQL NULL - the Java read it through String.valueOf, which renders a SQL NULL as the text "null".

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE eb (bn BINARY(5), v VARCHAR(20), vt VARIANT, i INT)
INSERT INTO eb SELECT TO_BINARY('AB'), 'hello', PARSE_JSON('{"a": 1}'), 7
SELECT BASE64_DECODE_STRING('qw==') AS x FROM eb
SELECT BASE64_DECODE_STRING(BASE64_ENCODE(bn)) AS x FROM eb
SELECT HEX_DECODE_STRING('AB') AS x FROM eb
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE eb (bn BINARY(5), v VARCHAR(20), vt VARIANT, i INT)
INSERT INTO eb SELECT TO_BINARY('AB'), 'hello', PARSE_JSON('{"a": 1}'), 7
SELECT TRY_BASE64_DECODE_STRING('qw==') AS x FROM eb
SELECT TRY_HEX_DECODE_STRING('AB') AS x FROM eb
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE eb (bn BINARY(5), v VARCHAR(20), vt VARIANT, i INT)
INSERT INTO eb SELECT TO_BINARY('AB'), 'hello', PARSE_JSON('{"a": 1}'), 7
SELECT BASE64_DECODE_STRING('aGVsbG8=') AS x FROM eb
SELECT BASE64_DECODE_STRING(BASE64_ENCODE(v)) AS x FROM eb
SELECT BASE64_DECODE_BINARY(BASE64_ENCODE(bn)) AS x FROM eb
SELECT TRY_BASE64_DECODE_STRING('aGVsbG8=') AS x FROM eb
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE eb (bn BINARY(5), v VARCHAR(20), vt VARIANT, i INT)
INSERT INTO eb SELECT TO_BINARY('AB'), 'hello', PARSE_JSON('{"a": 1}'), 7
SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('a', 1), 'a') AS x FROM eb

error.messageContains: Invalid argument types for function 'JSON_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT': (OBJECT, VARCHAR(1))

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE eb (bn BINARY(5), v VARCHAR(20), vt VARIANT, i INT)
INSERT INTO eb SELECT TO_BINARY('AB'), 'hello', PARSE_JSON('{"a": 1}'), 7
SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(vt, 'a') AS x FROM eb
SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT('{"a": 1}', 'a') AS x FROM eb
SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(i, 'a') AS x FROM eb
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE eb (bn BINARY(5), v VARCHAR(20), vt VARIANT, i INT)
INSERT INTO eb SELECT TO_BINARY('AB'), 'hello', PARSE_JSON('{"a": 1}'), 7
SELECT TRY_VALIDATE_UTF8(bn) AS x FROM eb
SELECT TRY_VALIDATE_UTF8(v) AS x FROM eb
SELECT TRY_VALIDATE_UTF8(i) AS x FROM eb
